name: investboard
description: Second brain for investing. Bring your portfolio, strategy and investment reasoning into your AI assistant.

interface.longDescription:
Investboard brings your portfolio, personal strategy and investment decisions together. Understand what you own, set out how you want to invest, and keep the reasons behind your choices. Bring that context into your AI assistant so each review can build on what you have already recorded.

What Investboard can do:

Investment Strategy Check: Assess proposed changes against your goals, allocation rules and constraints.

Investment Decision-Making: Work through alternatives, trade-offs and uncertainty, and reflect on previous decisions.

Investment Thesis: Develop and review your investment case, challenge its assumptions and define what would change your mind.

Portfolio Intelligence: Explore your holdings, look through equity funds, identify overlap and concentration, and understand diversification and historical correlations.

Start with your investing.md policy, research notes or reports, or connect your Investboard account to read your mandate, holdings, available analytics, saved checks, theses and journal entries.

Try prompts like:

- Help me understand my portfolio's underlying holdings, overlap and diversification.
- Check a change I am considering against my investment strategy.
- Help me develop an investment thesis and work through the decision.
- Explain what my portfolio's historical correlations can and cannot tell me.
- Review my recent investment decisions and the journal reviews that are due.
- I decided to defer the change we checked. Record that decision.

Requirements: Connected features require an Investboard account and the relevant access, permissions and sharing settings. Skills can also work with files you supply. Account tools save requested hypothetical checks and outcomes you ask to record.

Open Investboard to update your strategy, save a thesis or complete a journal review. You make every investment decision. Investboard does not place orders.
